answer: Each identity claims a dune plot and locks an 80-credit bond, filing its key-signed dawn temperature in the oasis registry. The registry publishes readings as a map for consistency checks: genuine readings vary gradually, while copied ones repeat across distant plots and invented ones jump between neighbors. A duplicate or out-of-tolerance reading burns its bond. With a 25-credit fee, the k-th fake still costs 105, and 1000 fakes cost 105,000, with no bulk discount. A rented sensor fails on claimant key mismatch. An honest identity pays 25 once, recovering its bond after a clean epoch.
